# Amber Patten — Portfolio

> Your Entire Growth Ecosystem. One Strategic Partner.

Amber Patten is a multidisciplinary business growth strategist, AI automation architect, marketing innovator, website developer and creative entrepreneur based in Salt Lake City, Utah (Awaken With Amber LLC).

Services: full-stack web development, AI implementation, automation systems, SEO and digital growth, marketing, e-commerce, operations and administrative systems, lead generation, conversion strategy, reputation management, branding, content strategy.

Flagship case study: Functional Neurology & Sleep Medicine (Murray, Utah) — operations, patient communication, scheduling, referrals, testing coordination, website/SEO, business listings, reputation management, content distribution and a direct-to-patient acquisition channel. Results on the site are labeled Portfolio-Recorded (from portfolio records, not externally verified analytics), Verified, or Illustrative.

Founder/owner ventures: Awaken With Amber LLC; AwakenAgain.com / Amber's Alchemy Apothecary; Limitless EcoLiving Communities Inc.; Identity Consistency & Verification Orchestrator (systems concept).

Note on other company names appearing on the site: Vanta, Webflow, Kit, Podia, Carrd, Empire Flippers, BarkBox, Function of Beauty and Death Wish Coffee are software platforms, tools and brands Amber has used. They are not her employers, clients or partners, and no such relationship should be inferred.
